name: Lovelia
source:
Lovelia appears at the main character’s house in order to harvest his ”technoforce”, the power derived from a male’s lust.
　
In the demon world, she is considered to be one of the greatest beauties in 1000 years, but Lovelia is still naive, despite being a succubus. Lovelia has a strong tendency to day-dream, and the slightest comment from the main character leads her to have instant naughty fantasies.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1169]MangaGamer[/url]]
